column1: # Maven POM fact counters, for a rule matching pom.xml files next to xml-facts: one per line, label TAB
# pattern (Java regex). The [ignore] line blanks comments, CDATA sections and the body of every
# <plugin> element first, so a commented-out dependency, a plugin's own dependencies and the words of a
# plugin configuration (SpotBugs detectors, assembly modules) do not count. "dependencies" counts every
# <dependency> of the dependencies, dependencyManagement and profile sections; "plugins" every plugin
# of build, pluginManagement, reporting and profiles; the two "managed ... sections" say whether there
# are any. A comment or CDATA section that is never closed runs to the end of the file. A plugin opener
# other than <plugin>, or plugins nested more than one level deep, are not read. Every pattern stays
# linear in the length of the file; XmlFactPatternsTest pins every case.
